item.title: Opened Ear
item.author: thekingsscribe7@gmail.com (se7en Adeniyi)
item.description:
A brief account of scribe 7's experience of the Word that came through Isaiah (50:5)

[03-13-13] “Send. “ | Isaiah 50v5

The LORD GOD has opened My ear [unto His preferred wavelength]
And I have not been rebellious [to insist on attuning my ear to the common air]
Nor have I turned back [from His counsel / commandment]

It is none but the LORD GOD, who has opened My ear.
Why HE?!

YHVH. Sovereign GOD.
What is the meaning of Your NAME?
Reveal, NOW, Yourself to me.

Who is YHVH?
That I should know?
That it may be clear to my Soul,
why I am called.
Why My ears are opened.

Yod - Hei - Vav - Hei

Y - Beginning-Ending. Faithful and True.
H - Ruach/Breath
V - Presence + Unity
H - Ruach

Called!
That as embodiment of Yod {Beginning-Ending},
I should breathe out—River of Water of LIFE (which is as air)
as I am the joining of Quasar and Earth realms:
GOD and Man.
El’s breath: Sovereign El “breathes Me. "

As Yod-Vav;
GOD and Man;
Father and Son;
Exchange Breath.

In comes GLORY,
out flows LIFE.
